title: Progressive rendering: fields before reasoning, skeletons, and non-blocking streaming

test_cases.name: Progressive rendering pipeline architecture
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect index.html for skeleton rendering and separate extraction/reasoning flows
test_cases.expected_result: SkeletonScreenRenderer defined with department skeletons for features before diagnosis
test_cases.evidence: Progressive rendering architecture defined with separate skeletons and staggered event handlers

test_cases.name: Loading indicator and skeleton shimmer CSS
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect CSS styles in index.html for skeleton screen and shimmer keyframes
test_cases.expected_result: Shimmer keyframe animations and skeleton CSS classes present
test_cases.evidence: Skeleton screen animations and styling present in index.html

test_cases.name: Performance monitoring and event-loop lag protection
test_cases.input_setup: Check ProgressivePerfMonitor class and latency measurement
test_cases.expected_result: ProgressivePerfMonitor monitors TTFS and section arrival latency

test_cases.name: Fluid streaming and staggered animation updates
test_cases.input_setup: Check for TypewriterStreamer or staggered fade animations in index.html
test_cases.expected_result: Staggered animation or streaming simulation defined
test_cases.evidence: Typewriter streaming and/or staggered render animations defined for gradual updates

test_cases.name: Terminal event hides loaders and displays full document
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect completion handler for skeleton cleanup
test_cases.expected_result: Loaders unmounted/hidden when terminal event arrives
test_cases.evidence: Terminal event removes skeleton loaders and unveils final content
